content: In our every deliberation, we must consider the impact of our decisions on the next seven generations.
author: Native American Proverbs
sourceWork: The Great Law of Peace (Gayanashagowa) — Haudenosaunee Confederacy
explanation: Short-term thinking is the curse of modern governance and business: decisions are made for the next election cycle or quarterly report, leaving ecological devastation and national debt for tomorrow. The Great Law demands visionary foresight: will this choice heal or harm your great-great-grandchildren?
practicalInsight: Make a long-term decision today with your family or business that prioritizes the health of the distant future over short-term gain.
reflectionPrompt: How would your life choices transform if you weighed them against the flourishing of seven generations ahead?
